run_spm_encode_pieces: run spm_encode.py to encode input text files into SentencePiece token pieces using a model
run_spm_encode_ids: run spm_encode.py with --output_format id to encode text into SentencePiece token IDs
run_spm_encode_with_length_filter: run spm_encode.py with --min-len and --max-len to filter encoded lines by token count
run_spm_encode_stdin: run spm_encode.py piping stdin to encode text and write encoded output to stdout
run_spm_encode_multiple_files: run spm_encode.py with multiple --inputs and --outputs to encode parallel files simultaneously
